reviewed_obligations: A size exception requires proof no position or orientation fits the base wholly within the ordinary disembark distance beside the Transport.
Congestion, terrain, enemy models and a poor proposed orientation do not prove the base is too large.
The exceptional model must have its base within one inch of the Transport base or hull and be unengaged.
Every other setup requirement remains applicable, including the complete rules unit's coherency.
The effective ordinary distance is three inches or the disembark mode's six-inch distance; a model that fits that ordinary distance does not qualify.
